reviews.body:
## Pull Request Overview

This PR fixes issue #187354 by preventing the "Add to .gitignore" menu option from appearing when right-clicking on the `.gitignore` file itself in the Git source control view.

Key changes:
- Added a `contextValue` getter to the `Resource` class that returns `'ignorable'` for all files except `.gitignore`
- Updated the menu contribution conditions to only show the "git.ignore" command when `scmResourceState == 'ignorable'`

### Reviewed Changes

Copilot reviewed 2 out of 2 changed files in this pull request and generated 2 comments.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| extensions/git/src/repository.ts | Added `contextValue` getter that returns `'ignorable'` for files that are not `.gitignore` |
| extensions/git/package.json | Updated menu conditions to require `scmResourceState == 'ignorable'` for the "git.ignore" command |
